title: brachyglottis × remotifolia
intro: Brachyglottis × remotifolia, commonly known as Pittosporum eugenioides, is a plant species in the family Pittosporaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in New Zealand, for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Brachyglottis × remotifolia include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial effects. The plant's therapeutic actions may also be attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiproliferative properties, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases.
